app_store_listing.long_description:
Transform your customer support with AI Chat Support's intelligent chat widget. Our advanced AI understands your products and can automatically answer customer questions about inventory, shipping, returns, and more - 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

**Key Features:**
• AI-powered responses trained on your store data
• Handles product questions, order status, and support inquiries
• Mobile-responsive chat widget
• Customizable design to match your brand
• Real-time analytics and conversation history
• Easy one-click setup
• No monthly subscriptions - pay only for what you use

**Perfect for:**
• E-commerce stores of all sizes
• Businesses wanting to reduce support workload
• Stores with international customers (24/7 support)
• Growing businesses scaling their customer service

**How it works:**
1. Install the app with one click
2. The AI learns about your products automatically
3. Chat widget appears on your storefront
4. Customers get instant answers to their questions
5. You save time and increase customer satisfaction

**Pricing:**
Flexible credit-based pricing starting at just $5 for 100K tokens (300-1000 conversations). Credits never expire, so you only pay for actual usage. Perfect for stores of any size.
